meta.title: ARPA Knowledge & Research Skills Ecosystem
meta.subtitle: Article Research & Publication Assistance
meta.brand_affiliation: Kelas Bisa Juara & Lulus, Brand Kelas Bisa, PT Brimo Swarnindo Karyavara
meta.abstract: ARPA is designed as an integrated ecosystem for research competency, scientific writing, and academic publication development. The framework combines structured learning, mentoring systems, and practical academic experience to support students, researchers, and academic communities in developing measurable scientific competencies.

core_domains.description: Focused on research methodology, literature exploration, research analysis, and research ethics.

core_domains.description: Focused on academic writing and scientific communication competency.

core_domains.name: Publication & Presentation Domain
core_domains.description: Focused on scientific publication and academic presentation competency.

expected_outcomes.title: 3. Results & Discussion
expected_outcomes.description: Through the integration of research competency domains and academic skill tools, participants are expected to develop comprehensive academic capabilities.

conclusion.title: 4. Conclusion
conclusion.text: ARPA is positioned as a research and scientific publication ecosystem that combines structured competency development, mentoring systems, and practical academic experience to support sustainable academic and scientific growth.
